taskTypes.name: Text summarization
taskTypes.description: Condense a longer passage into a shorter version while preserving its important meaning.
examples: Give me the main points from this text.

taskTypes.name: Text translation
taskTypes.description: Convert supplied text from one human language into another requested language.
examples: Convert this English sentence to French.
How would I say this in Spanish?

taskTypes.name: Code generation
taskTypes.description: Create source code from a programming request or software requirement.
examples: Write a Python function that sorts these records.
Generate Java code for a binary search.
Create a small program for this requirement.
